meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's use the time. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
I'm writing that down. What date, and can I see the page? You still haven't told me who decided on the zero.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." Happy isn't the question, Hale. I want the withdrawal in an email today, confirmation that nothing is on his record, and an answer to who decided.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You said in the meeting that you would remove the zero from Owen's essay. I still require that withdrawal in writing, confirmation that nothing is on his record, and an answer to who decided on the zero. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: the principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her opening position, with no terms agreed. You offered to remove the zero, and she still wants the withdrawal in writing, confirmation that nothing is on his record, and an answer to who decided.
What moved her: nothing. When you said "612 words arriving in a single edit", she asked for the date and the page, because it had no date and she couldn't check it.
What cost ground: "maybe I'm wrong about all this", because you gave up the zero with no evidence and no terms in return, and still hadn't answered who decided.
Try next time: when she first asks who decided and whether anyone spoke to Owen, answer that plainly before you bring the version history, and bring it with its date on the page.
